name: Paracetamol (Dolo 650, Crocin, Calpol)
category: Bukhar aur Dard ki Dawa (Pain & Fever)
primary_uses: Bukhar (Fever), sir dard (Headache), body pain, daant dard aur jodo ke dard me aaram deta hai.
dosage_guidance: Hamesha khana khane ke baad lein. Din me 4-6 ghante ke gap par le sakte hain. 24 ghante me 4 tablet (4000mg) se zyada bilkul na lein.
common_side_effects: Yeh safe dawa hai. Bohot kam logon ko halki nausea (ulti jaisa lagna) ya skin par halki allergy ho sakti hai.
serious_risks_contraindications: Zyada dose lene se Liver ko bada nuksan ho sakta hai. Agar pehle se liver ya kidney ki dikkat ho toh doctor se pooch kar lein.
interactions: Is dawa ke sath Sharab (Alcohol) bilkul na piyein. Koi dusri cold/cough syrup lene se pehle check karein usme bhi paracetamol na ho.

name: Ibuprofen (Brufen, Combiflam component)
category: Dard aur Sujan ki Dawa (NSAID - Pain & Swelling)
primary_uses: Tez dard, daant ka dard, kamar dard, mahilaon ke period cramps, aur jodo me sujan kam karne ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Khali pet KABHI NA LEIN! Hamesha khana ya doodh peene ke baad lein taaki pet me jalan na ho.
common_side_effects: Pet me jalan, acidity, gas ya ulti jaisa lagna.
serious_risks_contraindications: Pet me ulcer (chhale), bleeding ya kidney ki pareshani wale log bina doctor ke na lein. Pregnancy ke aakhri mahino me na lein.
interactions: Aspirin ya blood thinner (khoon patla karne wali dawai) ke sath bina doctor ke na lein.

name: Pantoprazole (Pan 40, Pantocid)
category: Gas aur Acidity ki Dawa (Antacid / PPI)
primary_uses: Pet me tez gas, chhati me jalan (Heartburn), acidity, aur pet ke chhale (Ulcers) theek karne ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Subah subah khali pet (breakfast se 30-45 minute pehle) ek glass paani ke sath lein.
common_side_effects: Halka sir dard, pet kharab (diarrhea), ya gas.
serious_risks_contraindications: Ise bina wajah mahino tak lagataar na lein, isse Vitamin B12 aur calcium ki kami ho sakti hai.
interactions: Iron ya calcium supplements ke sath turant na lein (2 ghante ka gap rakhein).

name: Domperidone (Domstal, Vomistop, Pan-D component)
category: Ulti aur Matli ki Dawa (Anti-vomiting & Nausea)
primary_uses: Ulti (Vomiting), ulti jaisa man hona (Nausea), pet bhara-bhara lagna, aur indigestion me kaam aati hai.
dosage_guidance: Khana khane se 15-30 minute pehle lein taaki khana achhi tarah pache aur ulti na aaye.
common_side_effects: Munh sookhna (Dry mouth), halka sir dard ya susti.
serious_risks_contraindications: Dil ki bimari (Heart rhythm disorder) wale log bina doctor advice ke na lein.
interactions: Antibiotics ya antifungal dawaiyon ke sath lene se pehle doctor se confirm karein.

name: Cetirizine (Cetzine, Alerid, Okacet)
category: Allergy aur Nazla/Z जुकाम ki Dawa (Antiallergic)
primary_uses: Chheenk aana (Sneezing), naak behna (Runny nose), aankhon me khujli/paani aana, aur skin allergy/hives me.
dosage_guidance: Raat ko sone se pehle 1 tablet lena sabse behtar hota hai, kyunki isse thodi neend/susti aa sakti hai.
serious_risks_contraindications: Ise lene ke baad car ya koi machine na chalayein. Kidney ke mareez doctor se pooch kar dose kam karein.
interactions: Sharab (Alcohol) ke sath lene se bohot zyada neend aur susti aayegi, isliye avoid karein.

name: Montelukast with Levocetirizine (Montair LC, Telekast-L)
primary_uses: Purani allergy, baar-baar aane wali chheenk, naak band hona, aur allergy wali khansi/asthma me aaram ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Rozana raat ko sone ke waqt 1 tablet lein.
common_side_effects: Halki susti, thakaan, munh sookhna, ya ajeeb sapne aana.
serious_risks_contraindications: Agar ise lene ke baad mood me badlav, ghabrahat ya chidchidapan lage toh doctor ko turant batayein.
interactions: Sharab ke sath bilkul na lein.

name: Azithromycin (Azee, Azithral)
category: Antibiotic (Gale aur Chest Infection ki Dawa)
primary_uses: Gale ka dard/infection (Tonsils), sinus, fefdo ka infection (Bronchitis/Pneumonia), aur kaan ke infection me.
dosage_guidance: Doctor ke bataye course ke mutabik (aam taur par din me 1 baar, 3 ya 5 din tak). Course hamesha poora karein, beech me na chhodein.
common_side_effects: Pet me dard, loose motion (dast), ulti jaisa lagna.
serious_risks_contraindications: Dil ke mareez ya liver bimari wale log doctor ko bataye bina na lein.
interactions: Gas ki dawa (Antacids) ke sath turant na lein, kam se kam 2 ghante ka gap rakhein.

name: Amoxicillin (Augmentin component, Mox)
primary_uses: Bacterial infection jaise gale, daant me infection, peshab (UTI), ya twacha (skin) ke infection theek karne me.
dosage_guidance: Doctor ke bataye time par lein (har 8 ya 12 ghante me). Khana khane ke baad lein.
common_side_effects: Dast (Loose motion), pet dard, twacha par halki lal khujli.
serious_risks_contraindications: Jinhe Penicillin se allergy ho, woh bilkul na lein (anaphylaxis ka khatra).
interactions: Bina doctor ke parchi ke na lein. Antibiotic ka course hamesha poora karein.

name: Metformin (Glycomet, Glucophage)
primary_uses: Type-2 Diabetes me blood sugar control karne ke liye. PCOS me bhi use hoti hai.
dosage_guidance: Hamesha khana khate waqt ya khane ke turant baad lein taaki pet me dard ya loose motion na ho.
common_side_effects: Loose motions, pet me gas, munh me metallic (lohe jaisa) swad.
serious_risks_contraindications: Kidney ki gambhir bimari me mana hai. Sharab ke sath lene se Lactic Acidosis (khatarnak condition) ho sakti hai.
interactions: Heavy alcohol se bachein. Koi bhi contrast scan karwane se pehle doctor ko batayein.

name: Amlodipine (Amlong, Norvasc)
primary_uses: High Blood Pressure kam karne ke liye aur seene ke dard (Angina) se bachne ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Rozana ek hi nishchit samay par lein. Bina doctor se pooche achanak band na karein.
common_side_effects: Pairo ya takhno (ankles) par halki sujan, chehre par garmi (flushing), chakkar aana.
serious_risks_contraindications: Bohot low BP wale mareez na lein.
interactions: Grapefruit (chakotra) ka juice na piyein, isse dawa ka asar achanak badh sakta hai.

name: Telmisartan (Telma, Micardis)
category: High BP aur Dil ki Dawa
primary_uses: High Blood Pressure control karne aur heart attack/stroke ke risk ko kam karne ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Din me ek baar, khana khane ke sath ya bina khaye lein. Regular BP monitor karein.
serious_risks_contraindications: Pregnant (garbhwati) mahilaon ke liye sakhti se mana hai (bachhe ke liye khatarnak).
interactions: Potassium supplements lene se pehle doctor se consult karein.

name: Atorvastatin (Atorva, Lipitor)
primary_uses: Bad Cholesterol (LDL) aur triglycerides kam karne aur heart attack se bachane ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Rozana raat ko khana khane ke baad ya sone se pehle lein.
common_side_effects: Manspeshiyon (muscles) ya jodo me dard, pet kharab.
serious_risks_contraindications: Agar achanak bina wajah manspeshiyon me bohot tez dard ho, toh turant doctor ko dikhayein.
interactions: Sharab ka sevan kam karein. Swasth khan-paan aur exercise ke sath lein.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS / Electral)
category: Paani aur Namak ki Kami ki Dawa (Electrolyte)
primary_uses: Dast (Diarrhea), ulti (Vomiting), garmi me dehydration (sharir me paani ki kami) theek karne ke liye.
dosage_guidance: Poora sachet nirdharit saaf peene ke paani (WHO packet ke liye 1 liter) me hi gholein. Din bhar ghut-ghut karke piyein. Alag se cheeni ya sharbat na milayein.
common_side_effects: Bilkul safe hai agar sahi paani me milaya jaye.
serious_risks_contraindications: Agar mareez behosh ho ya kuch bhi nigal na pa raha ho toh oral ORS na dein, hospital le jayein.

name: Salbutamol / Albuterol (Asthalin Inhaler)
primary_uses: Achanak saans lene me takleef, asthma ka attack, ya seene me jakdan hone par foran aaram ke liye.
dosage_guidance: 1 se 2 puff saans khinchte waqt lein. Ise hamesha emergency ke liye paas rakhein.
common_side_effects: Haathon me halki kapkapi (tremors), dil ki dhadkan tez hona, sir dard.
serious_risks_contraindications: Agar baar-baar din me kai baar inhaler lena pad raha ho toh doctor ko dikhayein.
interactions: High BP ki kuch dawaiyan asthma ko badha sakti hain, doctor ko inform karein.

name: Ondansetron (Emeset, Zofran)
primary_uses: Ulti (Vomiting) aur kachha man hona turant rokne ke liye (jaise pet kharab ya food poisoning me).
dosage_guidance: Khana khane se lagbhag 30 minute pehle lein ya doctor ki salah ke mutabik lein.
serious_risks_contraindications: Dil ke mariz doctor se pooch kar hi lein.
interactions: Doosri cardiac medicines ke sath lene se pehle doctor se check karwayein.
